text:
ben: deploy-bot blocked promotion to prod — staging e2e is failing after lib-analytics bumped to 2.4.0. Change window in 2h, need quick decision.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: 1 failing job (staging-e2e). See CI: https://ci.internal/runs/98765 :no_entry:

alice: looking now, grabbing logs.

carmen: saw this locally — NPE in metric aggregator during end-to-end load step. stacktrace points at AnalyticsSerializer.deserialize.

ben: did the bump come from a prod-intent PR or an infra sync?

alice: PR #4382 bumped it, author is @dave (data infra). It pulled protobuf changes.

dave: yep I merged it earlier today to fix a schema mismatch for nightly jobs. didn't run full staging e2e though, my bad.

carmen: quick paste of failing line: ```java.lang.NullPointerException at com.redwood.analytics.AnalyticsSerializer.deserialize(AnalyticsSerializer.java:142)```

ben: can we pin back to 2.3.7 for the release window and then roll forward with a revert PR once tests green?

eve: pin PR is fastest. I'll open one to force 2.3.7 in staging and create a follow-up to fix the serializer.

alice: slight risk: the schema fix might be required for some background jobs on prod. Are we sure pin won't break anything?

dave: checked — the nightly job that needed schema should tolerate older lib; I verified compatibility. pin is safe for the short window.

ben: OK do pin. Also add a note to the release notes: "temporary dependency pin for staging due to lib-analytics serialization issue; rolling forward planned".

eve: opening PR now — #4390. CI kicked off. cc @deploy-bot for unblock when green.

deploy-bot: PR #4390 merged into staging by eve. Running promote pipeline.

alice: staging-e2e now passing on the new run, looks clean :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed: staging -> prod queued. ETA ~10m.

ben: we'll hold manual approval until the release window start. schedule a rollback runbook just in case.

carmen: creating rollback doc in runbooks/analytics-pin-rollback.md and linking in the release ticket.

dave: I'll follow up with a proper fix for the serializer and open a rollforward PR next week.

ben: thanks all — good coordination. Marking this resolved for the immediate release unblock. Follow-ups: #4391 (serializer fix), runbook, and a postmortem note.
